description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing Recurring Deposit Accounts within the Apache Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for template retrieval, listing, creation, retrieval, modification, command handling (approve, reject, activate, close, etc.), deletion, and bulk import of recurring deposit accounts. The class utilizes JAX-RS annotations for REST path definitions and Swagger annotations for API documentation. It interacts with various services for reading account data, security validation, serialization, command processing, and bulk import functionality.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountsApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class for managing Recurring Deposit Accounts, including creation, retrieval, update, deletion, operations, and bulk import functionalities.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Retrieves a template for creating or maintaining recurring deposit accounts. Includes defaults and allowed values to facilitate UI development.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Lists all recurring deposit applications or accounts, with support for pagination, sorting, and field selection.

methods.name: submitApplication
methods.description: Submits a new recurring deposit application with the provided JSON payload.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific recurring deposit account by account ID, with optional association data.

methods.name: populateTemplateAndAssociations
methods.description: Helper method to populate account data with associated transactions and charges based on requested associations.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Modifies an existing recurring deposit application, applicable when in 'Submitted and pending approval' state.

methods.name: handleCommands
methods.description: Handles various commands/actions (approve, reject, activate, close, calculate interest, post interest, etc.) for a specific account based on query parameters.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Utility method to compare command or status strings case-insensitively.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a hard delete of a recurring deposit application in 'Submitted and pending approval' state.

methods.name: accountClosureTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a closure template for a specific account, such as for closing or closing with liability.

methods.name: getRecurringDepositTemplate
methods.description: Provides an Excel template for bulk import of recurring deposit accounts.

methods.name: postRecurringDepositTemplate
methods.description: Uploads and processes an Excel template file for bulk import of recurring deposit accounts.

methods.name: getRecurringDepositTransactionTemplate
methods.description: Provides an Excel template for bulk import of recurring deposit transactions.

methods.name: postRecurringDepositTransactionsTemplate
methods.description: Uploads and processes an Excel template for recurring deposit transactions bulk import.
